If Mata Hari w/ Anarch Secession plays Terra Incognita, does she lose
the anarch counter?

Mata Hari- You and she may play cards that require a sect and/or clan
as if she were of that required sect or clan

Anarch Secession- Burn the anarch counter if this vampire changes
sects.
